test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was the winner of the National Film Award in 2002 for his choreography in the Hindi movie ‘Lagaan’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Raju Khan__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Raju Khan ​

 
 
• **Raju Khan** is a famous **Bollywood Choreographer**.
 
• He is the **son** of acclaimed choreographer **Saroj Khan**.
 
• He began his career in the late '80s with the movie **Dacoit, Sadak**, etc.
 
• He achieved greater success with movies like '**Koi Mil Gaya**' and '**Lagaan**' his work was most acknowledged and polished.
 
• In the year **2002**, he went on to win the **National Film Award **for the Hindi movie '**Lagaan**'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ahmed Khan** is an Indian **Producer, Director, Writer, **and** Choreographer**.
 
• **Dinesh Kumar** is an Indian Choreographer working in South Indian Films, he won **The National Award for Best Choreography** in the year **2011** for his work in **Aadukalam**.
 
• **Shiamak Davar** is an Indian Choreographer noted as the **first** to bring **Contemporary Jazz and western forms** of dance to India.
